network_status.network: ARPAE regional tele-hydrometric network and validated event report
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto validato 16-18 maggio documenta la piena e gli effetti sul reticolo romagnolo, ma non pubblica una sezione idrometrica sul Fosso Ghiaia compatibile con questo ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The validated 16-18 May report documents the flood and its effects on the Romagna drainage network, but publishes no gauge section on Fosso Ghiaia compatible with this bridge.

sources.title: Ponte crollato a Ravenna, azienda isolata: «Servono 50mila euro per quello provvisorio»

curation_note.it: La revisione del rapporto ufficiale conferma il contesto di piena, ma non una misura sul Fosso Ghiaia. Il dossier registra esplicitamente il limite e non usa come sostituto una stazione su un altro corso d’acqua.
curation_note.en: Review of the official report confirms the flood context, but not a measurement on Fosso Ghiaia. The dossier records the limitation explicitly and does not substitute a gauge on another watercourse.

provenance.method: Manual extraction and coverage review of the official validated event report

caveats: No compatible event-specific gauge section for Fosso Ghiaia is published in the reviewed ARPAE event report.
The absence of a published compatible measurement does not imply absence of flooding at the bridge.
Hydrometric values from nearby monitored rivers are not transferred to this minor canal.
The documented process evidence remains distinct from a measured stage or discharge at the bridge.
